Definition: from the alternate of G4098; a crash, i.e. downfall (literally or figuratively):--fall.
BiblicalUsage: Ptosis means a fall, a crash, a downfall. Simeon said of the child Jesus, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel. And the house built on the sand fell, and great was the fall of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fall is the choice every man makes with Christ: He is set for the fall of some and the rising of others, and the same house falls or stands by its foundation.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
